asymmetry_principles.title: Chasing Run-Rate Pressure vs Tail Closure
asymmetry_principles.explanation: Batters face severe pressure when the required run rate climbs above 10.0 rpo regardless of wickets lost, whereas bowlers experience pressure when defending narrow margins or facing top-order power hitters.

asymmetry_principles.title: First-Innings Resource Modeling
asymmetry_principles.explanation: Because chasing targets do not exist in the first innings, pressure leverage is modeled via FirstInningsResourceModel estimating E[Remaining Runs | Competition, Over Bucket, Wickets Lost] against competition-level empirical resource grids (IPL benchmark: 183.0, Senior T20I: 165.2). The first-innings resource grid does not use innings-phase conditioning.

asymmetry_principles.title: DLS Uncertainty Isolation
asymmetry_principles.explanation: Deliveries bowled during rain-interrupted chases prior to revised target confirmation are strictly flagged and excluded from primary player ranking models to prevent artificial rate distortion.
